request.style: English, fast contemporary gospel, a powerful mass choir with tight stabs, slap bass, Hammond organ, horns and hard-hitting drums, the choir director calling out, a praise break with double-time drums at the end, 138 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The stone the builders rejected
Has become the cornerstone
This is the Lord's doing
It is marvelous in our eyes

[Chorus]
This is the day, this is the day
That the Lord has made
We will rejoice, we will rejoice
And be glad in it

[Verse]
You are my God and I will thank you
You are my God, I will exalt you
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good
His steadfast love endures forever

[Chorus]
This is the day, this is the day
That the Lord has made
We will rejoice, we will rejoice
And be glad in it

[Bridge]
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice
Be glad, be glad, be glad

[Chorus]
This is the day, this is the day
That the Lord has made
We will rejoice, we will rejoice
And be glad in it
